Name: FS - Wearable vanilla weapons and tools
Author: Talonerd
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod adds a total of 204 accessories to the Fashion Sense framework. [/b][/size][size=5]
[/size][size=3]
This includes two versions for each vanilla weapon (left and right), 4 versions for each vanilla tool (left, right, upright left, upright right) and 3 extra accessories (a leather scabbard, a leather strap and a leather support for handles) to complete your look.


[b]These accessories are the vanilla weapons, most tools and fishing rods, allowing you to wear your favorite tools on your back.
[/b][/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]* As a bonus, I also added a leather scabbard and leather belt straps to complement the accessories. Search for "Leather" and "Scabbard" to find them.

[youtube]hDEIvJxaIEg[/youtube]
[/size]

[size=3][b]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/b][/size][size=4][b]


[/b][b]Mods used in the screenshots:[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[/b] ﻿- buff arms from Farmer De-twinkification [b][[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18701?tab=description]link[/url][/size][size=4][b]]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]

[/b][b]DISCLAIMERS:[/b][/size][size=2]
[/size][size=3]- ﻿I did not create most of the textures for weapons and tools in this pack, they are mostly vanilla. Credit goes to Concerned Ape.
- I will not take requests of modded weapons/textures unless the original author of the textures﻿ grants permission to do so.
﻿- I will be releasing the python utility script I created to automate "FS-izing" textures later when the code is more polished.
﻿  This tool will allow you to convert modded weapons and textures for [u]personal use[/u] in your game.[/size]
